Exchange an invitation secret for membership under the verified Firebase identity, including anonymous identities. The secret is not a bearer credential.

101.description: Switching Protocols to opaque update frames

RegisteredDocument.description:
Registry hints for repairing a missing personal catalog reference. Authorization
is always checked by the document before any bytes are returned.

RegisteredDocuments.description:
One page of the account's registrations in document order. An account has no
document cap, so the list is read with `?after=<next>` until `next` is absent.

next.description: The cursor for the following page: this page's last document. Absent on the last page.

RoomInfo.description:
A document's seed and app, read by any member. Access and the invitation secret are
only in `AccessState`.

compact.description: Whether retained updates have reached the size at which a member may compact.
